text:
maria.sales: FYI — Customer (gov agency) asked if we can do a sealed POC w/ no egress. Main asks: signed sideload bundles, upgrade cadence guarantees, acceptance criteria, and pricing for air-gapped support.

owen.se: we can support signed bundles. two variants: full bundle (~3GB) or chained delta chunks. signing using our signing service; customer wants on-site key signing?

devon.eng: technical note: for delta chunking we'd sign each chunk with ed25519 and include manifest v2. Bootstrapping uses an offline token; operator runs:
```
redwood-cli bootstrap --token <TOKEN> --bundle ./bundle.tar.gz
```
We need to ship root CA cert in the bundle. Rolling upgrades: supported but customer wants 6-month cadence with explicit hotfix windows.

alyssa.sec: HSM/KMS: we can offer customer-managed HSM for signing or we can provide signed artifacts with time-limited attestations. If they require key custody on-prem, add-on + SOW.

sam.legal: pricing: sealed env support is a contract add-on. Typical pricing is one-time packaging + monthly sealed support fee. Will need their security questionnaire filled; I'll draft answers for Attestation, SBOM, and CVE policy.

maria.sales: acceptance tests — they want: 1) deploy success w/o egress, 2) inference throughput meets 150 req/s baseline, 3) p95 latency <= 250ms for 512 tokens, 4) offline rollback tested, 5) signed bundle verification logs available.

devon.eng: two blockers: 1) bootstrap token expiry — ops wants 72h validity for PoC; 2) bundle signing lead time — build & sign pipeline currently 48-72h turnaround for airgap images.

owen.se: can we accelerate signing? maybe pre-signed delta for PoC. Also need to confirm USB/shipper chain-of-custody if they request sneakernet.

alyssa.sec: Questions from the questionnaire: do we support FIPS certs? yes via our signing pipeline if customer provides FIPS HSM. EDR: we need process for offline telemetry opt-out — add config flag `telemetry.enabled=false` in /etc/redwood/config.

sam.legal: SOW note: include governance clause for emergency hotfixes and rollback SLAs. Also confirm licensing for quantized bundles (they asked about model weights licensing).

maria.sales: timeline ask — customer wants PoC next month; we need runbook, signed PoC bundle, A/C checklist, and pricing estimate by EOD Friday. @owen.se can you own runbook? @sam.legal handle pricing lines?

owen.se: I can own runbook. I'll stub the checklist today and add commands + verification steps.

sam.legal: I'll push a pricing draft and high-level SOW by EOD.

devon.eng: I'll open a ticket for build pipeline to prioritize a pre-signed PoC bundle and tag `poc/customer-x`.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline created: ci/redwood/airgap/poc-customer-x (ref #12345)

maria.sales: perfect. next sync tomorrow 10am PT. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
